title: International territorial level 2, January 2021 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: The middle tier of the ITL geography used for UK economic statistics, between the ITL1 nations and regions and the ITL3 local areas.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "International_Territorial_Level_2_January_2021_UK_BGC_V2_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/International_Territorial_Level_2_January_2021_UK_BGC_V2_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 41 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
